title: US, Iran Exchange Tanker Attacks as War Continues
description:
The US and Iran carried out what appeared to be their largest tit-for-tat tanker strikes yet over the weekend. The US military said it struck three Iranian crude tankers, while Iran said it hit three US-linked ships taking an unauthorized route through the Strait of Hormuz in retaliation. Bloomberg's Abeer Abu Omar reports.
